design_philosophy: A bold, futuristic, and professional gaming platform. Combines deep matte blacks with neon gold accents. Strict avoidance of generic purple/teal tech themes. Prioritizes sharp edges, high contrast, and a 'tactical' feeling of high stakes and real money.

headings.usage: H1-H6, brand name, and key metrics (wallet balance)

body.usage: Paragraphs, form labels, small text, and standard UI elements

buttons.primary: Background #FFD700, Text #000000, Font 'Unbounded' bold, sharp borders (radius 4px), hover effect: drop-shadow 0 0 12px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4) and transform translate-y -2px. transition: all 0.2s ease.
buttons.secondary: Background transparent, Border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), Text #FFFFFF, hover effect: border #FFD700, text #FFD700.

cards.style: Glassmorphism. Background rgba(20,20,28,0.7), backdrop-filter blur(16px). Border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Add a subtle inner light via box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1).
cards.hover_state: Border glows to rgba(255,215,0,0.3) and slight scale-up (transform: scale(1.02)).

forms.inputs: Background #0F0F16, Border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), padding 16px, text #FFFFFF, placeholder #A1A1AA. Focus state: Border #FFD700, outline none, box-shadow 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,215,0,0.2).
forms.labels: Font Outfit 14px, uppercase, tracking 1px, color #A1A1AA, margin-bottom 8px.
forms.file_upload: Dashed border (2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.2)), background rgba(20,20,28,0.5), padding 32px, text-align center, cursor pointer. Hover state changes border to dashed #FFD700.

navigation.style: Sticky top, height 80px, glassmorphism background (rgba(10,10,15,0.8), blur 20px), border-bottom 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Flexbox layout: Logo left, Links center, CTA/Profile right.

landing_page.hero: Center-aligned text overlaying a high-contrast abstract neon gold gaming background. H1 'PLAY. WIN. CONQUER.' in Unbounded 64px. Subtitle in Outfit 20px. Massive primary CTA button. Overlay must be rgba(10,10,15,0.85) gradient to ensure text readability.
landing_page.features: Bento grid layout showcasing 'Fair Play', 'Instant Withdrawals', 'Secure KYC'.

signup_login.layout: CSS Grid 2-column on desktop. Left column: Image of a person playing on a smartphone, 100% height, object-fit cover, with a subtle dark overlay. Right column: Centered form container (max-width 400px).
signup_login.signup_specifics: Includes inputs for Full Name, Phone, Email, Password, KYC Document Type (Select dropdown: Aadhaar, PAN, DL, Passport), and a File Upload zone.

dashboard.layout: Solid top nav. Main content area: Grid layout.
dashboard.wallet_card: Prominent top card. Background gradient from #14141C to #1A1A00. Large balance text in Unbounded, neon gold color.
dashboard.game_grid: CSS Grid (repeat auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)). Cards for Ludo and Snake & Ladder displaying the game image, entry fee, and 'Play Now' button.

game_view.layout: 2-column layout. Left: Large visualization of the board game image with a sleek border. Right: Game details, current active players list, and an 'Enter Match' CTA.

profile.layout: Single column, max-width 800px center. Top section: Avatar image, User Name, and a 'KYC Verified' badge in success_neon (#00E676) with a check icon. Below: Details and history.

micro_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state in 0.2s. Buttons lift up (-2px), cards glow borders.
micro_interactions.focus_states: Forms must explicitly highlight the active input field with a gold ring.
micro_interactions.loading: Use a subtle pulsing neon gold border for loading states.

landing_hero_bg.description: Abstract neon gold geometric shapes, perfect for the hero background with a heavy dark overlay.

auth_side_image.description: Man playing a video game on a smartphone, focused. For the left side of login/signup pages.

ludo_board.description: Close up of a vibrant Ludo game board. Use in Dashboard cards and Game View page.

snake_ladder_board.description: Checkered Snake and Ladders board game. Use in Dashboard cards and Game View page.

profile_avatar.description: Smiling person avatar for the profile page.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard, semantically correct HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript (No React, No Tailwind).
Use CSS Variables (:root) to define the color palette, fonts, and spacing for maintainability.
Implement Firebase Web SDK in the JS files for authentication and storage functionality. Initialize Firebase using standard configuration object.
Ensure all input fields, buttons, and crucial data containers have 'data-testid' attributes.
Apply 'glassmorphism' correctly using CSS backdrop-filter and semi-transparent backgrounds.
Inject the Phosphor icons script in the <head> of every HTML file.
Strictly follow the Dark/Gold aesthetic. Do not introduce off-brand colors like purple or teal.
